This block keeps your 3 weekly runs, 1 weekly 20 kg ruck, and 3 real strength sessions inside a 5-day week without stacking all gym work on consecutive days. Monday is squat + weighted pull-up + easy run, Wednesday is the key 3K session, Thursday is deadlift + press + strict pull-up, Saturday is the paced ruck, and Sunday is the low-cost unilateral/support strength + easy run day.

Weeks 2-4: the run quality progresses from 400 m repeats to longer 500-600 m work at current-calibrated pace, then Week 4 trims volume and sharpens pace. Pull-ups progress with one weighted day and one submax bodyweight day; only take the next step if the prior week stayed within the listed RPE and rep standard.

If shin pain shows up during or within 24 hours of Wednesday's run, repeat the last symptom-free week and first reduce that run session's pace or rep count before touching the easy runs. If irritation shows up after Saturday's ruck, hold or reduce the newest ruck pace change first while keeping 20 kg and walk-only execution. If fatigue is just general accumulated impact, trim Sunday's Chest-Supported Row first, then 5-10 minutes from Sunday's easy run before changing Wednesday quality.

Weekly running volume anchor: your established, tolerated baseline is about 18-20 km per week across 3 running exposures, and this block keeps 3 running exposures while quality becomes more 3K-specific. Counting easy runs, warm-up, repetitions and cooldown, Week 1 projects roughly 14.8 km, which is deliberately below that baseline while the new interval specificity is the only impact variable stepping up. While shins and next-day soreness stay normal, rebuild toward the top of your 18-20 km range by adding a few minutes to the easy runs first, never by adding a fourth running day or by making the easy runs faster. If shin symptoms return, reduce the stressor that provoked them or the one most recently increased, the interval session if symptoms follow that session, the ruck if they follow loaded carrying, and easy-run volume only for diffuse accumulated soreness, then repeat the last symptom-free week before progressing again.

Day	Exercise	Weight	Sets	Reps	Rest	Target RPE	Notes	Results
Mon	[WARMUP]	N/A	1	8 min	N/A	3	Squat-and-reach x 6; Bodyweight squat x 8; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Band shoulder pass-through x 10; Scapular push-up x 8; Ramp Back Squat: 47.5 kg x 5, 72.5 kg x 3, 92.5 kg x 1-2 before 120 kg work sets.; Keep the warm-up specific and non-fatiguing.	
Mon	Back Squat	120 kg	2	3	3:00	7	2-4 quick ramp sets, crisp bar speed, maintenance dose.	
Mon	Weighted Pull-up	+22.5 kg	3	4	2:30	7-8	Submaximal weighted support anchored below the demonstrated +30 kg x 5 benchmark; full hang, strict reps, no grind.	
Mon	Push-up	Bodyweight	2	15	1:00	6	Smooth reps, leave 3-4 reps in reserve.	
Mon	Run	Easy conversational pace	1	30 min	N/A	4	Flat route if possible; full-sentence breathing.	
Wed	[WARMUP] Run	Easy jog + drills + 3 relaxed strides	1	12 min	N/A	3-4	Same-day prep before the work reps.	
Wed	Run	1:42-1:45 per 400 m	5	400 m	2:00 walk/jog	7.5-8	3K-specific repeats; even splits; finish with 8 min easy jog cooldown.	
Thu	[WARMUP]	N/A	1	8 min	N/A	3	Hip-hinge drill x 8; Glute bridge x 10; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Band shoulder pass-through x 10; Wall slide x 8; Ramp Deadlift: 60 kg x 5, 90 kg x 3, 117.5 kg x 1-2 before 150 kg work sets.; Ramp Overhead Press: 22.5 kg x 5, 32.5 kg x 3, 42.5 kg x 1-2 before 55 kg work sets.; Keep the warm-up specific and non-fatiguing.	
Thu	Deadlift	150 kg	2	3	3:00	6.5-7	2-4 quick ramp sets; no grinders.	
Thu	Overhead Press	55 kg	3	5	2:00	7	Strict standing reps, no layback.	
Thu	Pull-up	Bodyweight	4	6	2:00	7	Clean dead-hang reps; stop 2 reps before failure.	
Thu	Side Plank	Bodyweight	2	30-40 s/side	45 s	6	Straight line from ribs to heels.	
Sat	Backpack Carry	20 kg @ 9:20-9:30/km	1	60 min	N/A	5-6	Brisk walk only; early step toward the 10 km goal; no jogging.	
Sun	Reverse Lunge	RPE-selected dumbbells	3	6/leg	90 s	7	Low-cost day; controlled descent and push through full foot.	
Sun	Chest-Supported Row	RPE-selected load	2	8	90 s	7	Keep 1-2 reps in reserve; first accessory to trim if time or recovery gets tight.	
Sun	Run	Easy conversational pace	1	35 min	N/A	4	Relaxed aerobic volume; finish fresher than you started.	
END_WEEK1_TSV
